Notes.Text:
This update for python-httplib2 fixes the following issue

- CVE-2026-59939: Fixed a vulnerability where a malicious or compromised HTTP server could return a small compressed payload that expands to an arbitrarily large size in memory and causes MemoryError or OOM-kill in the client process (bsc#1271095).
Notes.Title: Details

Notes.Title: Terms of Use

Vulnerabilities.Description: httplib2 is a comprehensive HTTP client library for Python. Prior to 0.32.0, httplib2 performs unbounded decompression of HTTP response bodies encoded with Content-Encoding: gzip or deflate in _decompressContent in httplib2/init.py, allowing a malicious or compromised HTTP server to return a small compressed payload that expands to an arbitrarily large size in memory and causes MemoryError or OOM-kill in the client process. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.
